nodes.description: Immutable IERC20 reference to the collateral asset held in custody by the CollateralLocker.
Immutable address of the Loan contract authorized to pull collateral from this locker.
Constructor that initializes collateralAsset and loan immutables from the supplied addresses.
Access-control modifier requiring msg.sender to equal the stored loan address; reverts with 'CL:NOT_L' otherwise.
External function guarded by isLoan that transfers amt of collateralAsset to destination dst.
msg.sender used in the isLoan modifier to authorize the caller against the stored loan address.
External token transfer (safeTransfer) that hands control to an arbitrary ERC20 contract, enabling reentrancy.
Constructor parameter address of the collateral asset token.
Constructor parameter address of the authorized Loan contract.
Destination address that pull transfers collateral to.
Amount of collateral asset that pull transfers to dst.

edges.reason: Constructor argument _collateralAsset is written into the immutable state variable collateralAsset.
Constructor argument _loan is written into the immutable state variable loan.
msg.sender is compared against the trusted loan address inside the isLoan modifier, performing the access-control check.
The stored loan address is the trusted value that msg.sender must match in the isLoan modifier.
The isLoan modifier gates execution of pull, reverting for non-loan callers.
pull invokes the external safeTransfer operation, transferring control to the collateral token before any state finalization.
The external token transfer can re-enter pull (via token hooks) before the transfer accounting completes, a classic reentrancy path.
Parameter dst flows into the safeTransfer recipient of the external call.
Parameter amt flows into the value of the safeTransfer external call.
